name: Feature-Preserving Volume Data Reduction and Focus+Context Visualization
definition: A technique that reduces volumetric data size while preserving features of interest and enabling focus+context visualization, using transfer function-driven continuous voxel repositioning and resampling.
summary: This method reduces volumetric data size by deforming the 3D grid to magnify important regions and compress unimportant ones, avoiding seams and information loss inherent in uniform downsampling.
